what: Curated Colour Palettes and Scales for ggplot2
title: Curated Colour Palettes and Scales for ggplot2
text: ggpalettes provides 26 original colour palettes native colour/fill scales ggplot2. compact pal_*() scale_*() interface feel familiar users scientific palette packages ggsci, catalogue focuses balanced, publication-ready colours ggcraft ecosystem.

title: Curated Colour Palettes and Scales for ggplot2
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("YaoxiangLi/ggpalettes")

title: Curated Colour Palettes and Scales for ggplot2
text: Every palette pal_*(), scale_color_*(), scale_colour_*(), scale_fill_*() forms. Generic interfaces also available: Categorical palettes default discrete scales. Sequential diverging palettes default continuous scales, plots need scale-mode argument.
code: library(ggpalettes) library(ggplot2)  gg_palette_names() gg_palette_info(type = "sequential")  # Palette functions: pal_name()(n) pal_meadow()(6) pal_aurora()(12)  ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, colour = Species)) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   scale_colour_clinical() +   theme_minimal()  ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_raster() +   scale_fill_ember() +   theme_minimal() scale_colour_ggpalette("atelier") scale_fill_ggpalette("balance") scale_fill_ggpalette("ocean", binned = TRUE)

title: Curated Colour Palettes and Scales for ggplot2
text: Categorical: meadow, atelier, clinical, spectrum, pastel, earth, midnight, floral, coastal, harvest. Sequential: aurora, ocean, ember, forest, orchid, slate, sunrise, glacier, berry, sand. Diverging: balance, temperature, earthsky, rosepine, lagoon, violetgold. Use gg_palette_plot() draw part catalogue. Use gg_palette_check() screen CIE Lab separation contrast selected background.
code: gg_palette_plot(type = "diverging", n = 9) gg_palette_check("meadow", background = "white")

title: ggpalettes 0.2.0
text: Expanded catalogue 26 original categorical, sequential, diverging palettes. Added pal_*() functions named scale_color_*(), scale_colour_*(), scale_fill_*() helpers every palette. Added automatic discrete, continuous, binned scale selection. Added gg_palette_info(), gg_palette_plot(), gg_palette_check() catalogue discovery, previews, palette diagnostics. Added alpha, direction, Lab/RGB interpolation controls.
